findings.reason: without a followup naming s46, s47 and s48, the three new sections enter no build invocation and the only open followup points at work already done.
findings.text: the plan's driving followup f-qwnw-008 queues `/reckon-build queued-work-needs-no-workaround §42 §43 §44 §45`, but the declarations at plan.html:23 now read `s42: done` and the three sections this review reads (`s46`, `s47`, `s48`) were added as implementable; a coordinator following the newest followup builds a finished section and never dispatches any of the three new ones

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every named module resolves at the reviewed revision (`reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py`, `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py`, `reckon/crew/landing_measure.py`, `reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py`, `reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py`), the three test files are new artifacts the section creates, and the cited refusal texts exist (§47's message at landing_measure.py:1508-1509; §48's at promotion_checks.py:2485-2486).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each of s46, s47 and s48 states a measurable head assertion beside a negative control that fires at the base revision (s46 defaults-alone derivation, s47 `landing measure unreadable` refusal, s48 `impl did not move` refusal).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the three sections write their evidence fragments under `docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/`, a durable repo path, and s46's and s47's gate tests are unit-level files under `tests/`, not session scratch.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new section titles and test filenames describe behaviour (`test_a_section_dispatch_takes_its_write_paths.py`, `test_a_landing_measures_the_tests_its_done_when_names.py`, `test_landing_a_sections_last_node_moves_impl.py`); only the declared evidence-fragment paths carry the node id, which is the house convention.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — each section's stated cause matches the code it rests on: §46's single dispatch fills `SECTION_SUPPLIED_NODE_FIELDS` without `write_paths` (dispatch_batch.py:655-700, `derive_write_paths=False`), §47's early return refuses before `importer_population` is used (landing_measure.py:1502-1521), and §48's impl derives from section declarations while the check compares impl at dispatch and completion (promotion_checks.py:2458-2491); none of the three prescribes a code path, formula or function.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s46 delivers write-path derivation for a single-section dispatch, s47 delivers a landing-measure fallback, s48 delivers an impl move on a section's last node; each is a single deliverable with one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the only driving followup, f-qwnw-008 at plan.html:489-492, queues §42 §43 §44 §45 while the same document's declarations (plan.html:23) now mark s42 done and add s46, s47 and s48 as implementable, so the three new sections are carried by no dispatch.
